summary.text: Jeff Crank is the Republican U.S. Representative for Colorado's 5th Congressional District and lost re-election on November 3, 2026 to Jessica Killin.

First elected in 2024 to succeed Doug Lamborn, the Colorado native was a congressional staffer, Colorado Springs Chamber of Commerce executive, Americans for Prosperity executive and radio host before entering Congress, and sits on the Armed Services and Natural Resources committees.

paragraphs.text: Crank was born in Pueblo, Colorado, in 1967, according to Ballotpedia; his official biography says he was born and raised in southern Colorado, the son of a school teacher's aide and a World War II Navy veteran who later managed a missile program at the Pueblo Army Depot.
He earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Colorado State University in 1990.

From 1991 to 1998 he worked in Washington, D.C., for Rep. Joel Hefley, focusing on military issues and serving as administrative director; his official biography says he helped author the Military Family Housing Privatization Act.
Crank then returned to Colorado to serve as vice president, later senior vice president, of the Colorado Springs Chamber of Commerce.
He later worked as chief operating officer at Americans for Prosperity (Ballotpedia describes the role as Colorado state director) and as president of his own real estate investment company.
He also has a broadcasting background, hosting The Jeff Crank Show on a Colorado Springs radio station and the American Potential Podcast.
Crank won the June 25, 2024 Republican primary over Dave Williams, 65.2% to 34.8%, and the November 2024 general election with 54.7% to 40.9% for the Democratic nominee, succeeding Doug Lamborn.
His committee assignments for 2025-2026 are Armed Services and Natural Resources.
He advanced from the June 30, 2026 Republican primary unopposed, and his official biography says he and his wife, Lisa, have two children.
He received 45.8% of the vote to Jessica Killin's 50.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
